$$B_k = X_k \cdot 10^{n-k} + Y_k$$
where $X_k$ is the number formed by the first $k-1$ digits and $Y_k$ is the number formed by the last $n-k$ digits.
We can express $A$ in terms of $B_k$ as:
$$A = 10 B_k + d_k \cdot 10^{n-k} - 9 Y_k$$

Since $|R_k| < B_k$, the only way $B_k$ can divide $R_k$ is if $R_k = 0$.
$$d_k \cdot 10^{n-k} - 9 Y_k = 0 \implies d_k \cdot 10^{n-k} = 9 Y_k$$
